mapper.sql: Post.Id, Post.BoardId, Post.UserId, Post.AnonymousIdentityId, Post.AnonymousName, Post.AnonymousAvatar, Post.AnonymousColor, Post.Title, Post.Content, Post.ContentText, Post.Images, Post.ViewCount, Post.ReplyCount, Post.LikeCount, Post.FavoriteCount, Post.ShareCount, Post.ReportCount, Post.HotScore, Post.IsTop, Post.IsEssence, Post.Status, Post.IpHash, Post.DeviceHash, Post.CreatedAt, Post.UpdatedAt, Post.Deleted, Board.Name as boardname, Board.Code as boardcode

select

mapper.insert: insert into Post(Id, BoardId, UserId, AnonymousIdentityId, AnonymousName, AnonymousAvatar, AnonymousColor, Title, Content, ContentText, Images, ViewCount, ReplyCount, LikeCount, FavoriteCount, ShareCount, ReportCount, HotScore, IsTop, IsEssence, Status, IpHash, DeviceHash, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, Deleted) values (#{id}, #{boardid}, #{userid}, #{anonymousidentityid}, #{anonymousname}, #{anonymousavatar}, #{anonymouscolor}, #{title}, #{content}, #{contenttext}, #{images}, #{viewcount}, #{replycount}, #{likecount}, #{favoritecount}, #{sharecount}, #{reportcount}, #{hotscore}, #{istop}, #{isessence}, #{status}, #{iphash}, #{devicehash}, #{createdat}, #{updatedat}, #{deleted})

insert into Comment(Id, PostId, UserId, RootId, ParentId, ReplyUserId, AnonymousIdentityId, AnonymousName, Content, LikeCount, ReplyCount, Status, CreatedAt) values (#{id}, #{postid}, #{userid}, #{rootid}, #{parentid}, #{replyuserid}, #{anonymousidentityid}, #{anonymousname}, #{content}, #{likecount}, #{replycount}, #{status}, #{createdat})
